svg.title: Chat with Vinícius Bedum
svg.desc: About me. Vinícius Bedum introduces himself: growth marketer, designer and founder of Bedum Media. He works with marketing, go-to-market, paid media, AI and SaaS products, B2B or B2C, and also writes code to solve real problems with a design touch. Based in Brazil and open to new opportunities. Email: vinicius@vncsbdm.xyz.
